summary.text: Shi Nu is a rockman Gu Immortal who kneels at a Shadow Sect secret base in Central Continent's Earth Abyss and pays respects to Ying Wu Xie.

claims.text: After they exchange the secret code, Ying Wu Xie tells him to stand. He kowtows three times, then stands, but his hands stay dropped, his legs stay closed tightly, and his body stays in a half-bowing posture, his eyes only gazing at Ying Wu Xie’s feet. The Gu Immortal aura from him is strong, at rank seven level.

He takes Ying Wu Xie through twisting dark tunnels to an underground chamber of dense yellowish-brown soil, with Gu formations around it and a soul sphere sinking and rising at the core. That soul sphere is Bo Qing’s soul. To look over this area, Shadow Sect subdued a group of rockmen and, after some nurturing, raised a rockman Gu Immortal: Shi Nu. When they were about to summon him, a wild one-eyed giant ape appeared, and he had to fight it and draw it away, so he was not summoned and survived. Ying Wu Xie tells Tai Bai Yun Sheng they have returned to Central Continent and are in Earth Abyss, that the rockmen here have already been transferred out, and that this is a secret base arranged by master.

Among Ying Wu Xie, Hei Lou Lan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, and Shi Nu, Shi Nu is the strongest. He is a rank seven variant human Gu Immortal and is completely loyal to Ying Wu Xie. He explains that Earth Abyss is not tranquil, that tremors can cause a gigantic cave-in, and that the aftermath can create desolate level blood beasts, bone beasts, or even blood path and earth path wild Immortal Gu.
When Ying Wu Xie gathers refinement materials through Defy, Shi Nu and Tai Bai Yun Sheng are not adept at negotiations.

He is a rockman, born with earth path dao marks, and his earth path cultivation is extremely useful in Earth Abyss. He has lived there for a long time. Ying Wu Xie sends him to a formation core to assist in refining Fixed Immortal Travel, and he answers that he will do his best even if he has to stake his life.

Ying Wu Xie decides to give up the Earth Abyss formation, leave Shi Nu to draw attention, and take Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Hei Lou Lan through the regional walls. Shi Nu’s rank seven cultivation level is a burden for those crossings. Shi Nu has no objections. He is utterly loyal, and he passes all of his accumulated Gu worms and the rockman tribe in his immortal aperture to Ying Wu Xie.
In the licorice regional wall he steps in front of the group, raises his right hand, and a tall and thick rock wall rises.
Ying Wu Xie commands him to protect Bai Ning Bing even if he has to sacrifice himself, and he nods with no hesitation.

He stamps his right leg and uses Spike Forest: countless spikes rise from the ground, then shoot to the air. He is the cornerstone of that fight. When a sheep ancient year beast charges, he gives a deep roar, his body suddenly bulges, turning into a giant that is as big as the year beast, and he throws the year beast to the ground. He is a rockman, a race with rich earth path dao marks, and he cultivates earth path mainly.

When the group still cannot leave the regional wall, he tells the others to go ahead and says he will hold Fang Yuan back. He activates Land Boundary. His whole body emits frightening cracking sounds, as cracks start appearing everywhere on his body, and the surrounding space is cut off from the space further out.

He raises his head, tells Ying Wu Xie to leave, and Ying Wu Xie says he will remember that loyalty. Because Shi Nu holds Fang Yuan back, the others leave the licorice regional wall and enter Northern Plains. He drops to the ground, laughs that he succeeded and that Shadow Sect will not be defeated, and hails Spectral Soul. Fang Yuan crushes him to pieces. Rock fragments and debris scatter over the ground with no signs of his original appearance. Fang Yuan picks the crucial piece, throws it down in Northern Plains, and a blessed land forms. Fang Yuan cannot subdue the land spirit or annex this rank seven blessed land, because his earth path attainment is only master, not grandmaster.
Fang Yuan captures Shi Nu’s soul but does not obtain it. Shadow Sect’s soul path attainment lets the soul dissipate.
